entities.name: Cassie An-Havva
entities.description: Villager of An-Havva with a zest for life, saved by Feroz from Sengir's Black Carriage.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Summoned a Brass Man to save Cassie.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire whose black carriage nearly ran Cassie down.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Partied with Cassie at the inn.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: Partied with Cassie at the inn.

events.summary: A black carriage with hellish horses barreled toward Cassie as Baron Sengir came to An-Havva.
events.quote: Baron Sengir was coming to An-Havva , and Cassie was directly in his path.

events.summary: Feroz summoned a Brass Man that knocked Cassie out of the carriage's path.
events.quote: The automaton knocked Cassie out of the carriage's path, saving her from certain death.
